column1: # Overlap against linking length for each revision of the same 76 halos.
# base is the adopted image. thV26.0, thV27.0, thg26.5 and thg27.5 change one threshold.
# sky29 and sky27 add a flat sky before the threshold. wing0 removes the outer wing.
# peak uses the component that contains the density-peak seed.
# nofb leaves the isophote empty when the centre pixel is below threshold.
# satin returns satellites of at least 100 stars to the image.
# thin2, thin4 and thin8 rebuild the image and the link from a nested subset.
# edge=1 means the maximum sits on a grid end and is not a matched linking length.
